card.title: Particles to black holes — the syllabus frontier

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Matter's basement has two families: quarks (locked in threes as baryons like protons/neutrons, or pairs as mesons) and leptons (electrons, neutrinos — loners that skip the strong force), each with an antiparticle mirror. The Big Bang's expanding aftermath is read in galactic redshift (Hubble: v = H₀d). The dark side — dark matter (unseen gravity), black holes (escape velocity > c), gravitational waves (ripples from colliding giants, heard by LIGO) — is where the syllabus ends and research begins.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: forces strong → EM → weak → gravity (strength order)  ·  Hubble: v = H₀·d (recession ∝ distance)  ·  baryons = 3 quarks (p = uud, n = udd); mesons = quark + antiquark  ·  black hole: escape velocity ≥ c within Schwarzschild radius

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Quarks never appear free (confinement — only hadrons reach detectors). Hubble's linear law holds for cosmological (not local gravitationally-bound) distances. Black-hole talk assumes general relativity past the event horizon; gravitational-wave detection needs kilometre-scale interferometry (LIGO) for sub-proton strains.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Neutrinos: near-massless, ghost through Earth by the trillion. Antimatter annihilates on contact (PET scans use positrons deliberately). Superconductors expel magnetic fields (Meissner) below Tc — the NEB 2023 2-marker: definition + two properties + one material.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: List the four forces in decreasing strength: strong nuclear > electromagnetic > weak nuclear > gravitational — spanning ~10³⁸ from strongest to weakest (NEB 2022, 2 marks). Same template answers 'elementary particles': quarks (baryons/mesons) + leptons (neutrinos) + force carriers.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: The Standard Model excludes gravity and dark matter/energy (~95% of the universe) — the syllabus frontier is honest about ignorance. Hubble 'constant' drifts with measurement tension. Tabletop claims (room-T superconductors) need extraordinary replication.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: From redshift z = Δλ/λ ≈ v/c for nearby galaxies, plotting v against distance d gives a straight line through the origin — slope H₀, the expansion rate; extrapolating backward converges ~13.8 billion years ago (Big Bang). Black-hole radius follows from setting escape velocity √(2GM/R) equal to c.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Force order: Strong–EM–Weak–Gravity (memorise S-E-W-G). Baryon = 3 quarks, meson = 2 (one anti). Redshift = receding = expanding. Superconductivity 2-marker: zero resistance + Meissner expulsion + one material (mercury/lead/niobium).

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (2): superconductivity — definition + two properties + one material. NEB 2022 (2): elementary particles + four forces in decreasing strength. NEB 2022 (5): ruby laser working + diagram + three uses.
